title: Products in the relative section kernel vanish
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], J ≤ I quasi-coherent ideal sheaves with I*I ≤ J [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]. On any etale J-subscheme object V, two global sections a,b of its structure ring [def-sc-gm-torsor] that restrict to zero after pullback to the I-subscheme satisfy a*b=0.

proof.text: Apply the square-zero kernel-ideal lemma to the two section hypotheses, then use Ideal.mul_le and membership in the bottom ideal to conclude the product is zero.

lean.statement:
theorem squareZeroRelativeSectionKernel (X : Scheme.{u})
    (I J : X.IdealSheafData) (hJI : J ≤ I) (hII : I * I ≤ J)
    (V : J.subscheme.Etaleᵒᵖ) (a b : J.subscheme.etaleStructurePresheaf.obj V)
    (ha : (etaleStructurePresheafToPullback (IdealSheafData.inclusion hJI)).app V a = 0)
    (hb : (etaleStructurePresheafToPullback (IdealSheafData.inclusion hJI)).app V b = 0) :
    a * b = 0
